items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf.
items.why: Weekend injury summary optimism path realized; Schefter/RapSheet confirmed official active.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; no lingering calf limitation reported post-activation.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary; no role reduction.

items.text: ETR GTD/PESSIMISM on Breece Hall; inactive for Jets vs Miami after quad; Allen handled work.
items.why: RapSheet: unlikely, not full participant; Schefter listed inactive.
items.implication: Missed fourth straight; monitor Week 8 practice for return timeline.

items.text: ETR EXPECTED TO PLAY Saquon Barkley; active vs Cowboys, gutsy efficient night then postgame hamstring/back fine.
items.why: Schefter/Rap confirmed active; Barkley: hamstring came out great, back won't keep him out.
items.implication: Limited carries (7/62/1) but efficient; monitor workload management ROS.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps; excited for Doyle cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite efficiency already; full Lamar unlocks higher volume/ceiling.
items.implication: Massive Week 8+ upside if Lamar returns vs Bills.
items.opportunity: YPRR + scheme fit with Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21% snaps; Harvey fluky long receiving TD.
items.why: Immediate lead role post-IR; Payton wants more touches.
items.implication: Coleman priority waiver/add; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded share.
items.opportunity: Snap/rush/route lead + coach endorsement = RB2/flex path.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after purposeful slide ankle twist; Campbell/Gibbs confirm should be good, pain gone.
items.why: Purposeful slide; initial pain resolved quickly; checked and cleared postgame.
items.implication: No missed time expected; remains RB1 (Lions full-PPR lead).
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/route share intact vs Vikings.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (high ankle); Huntley started; confident return path Week 8 vs Bills.
items.why: Missed third straight; limited practice; Wolfson notes confidence for Week 8.
items.implication: Huntley continues short-term; Flowers/Doyle upside with healthy Lamar pending.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers elevated YPRR even with Huntley; full offense unlock on return.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; opened slot/receiving opportunities (Lemon bet context).
items.why: ETR OUT list; Berry noted Cowboys soft vs slot with absences.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth tested; monitor Week 8 returns.
items.opportunity: Slot/routes vacated for Lemon or others.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/ACTIVE return; Berry discusses ROS fantasy value post-return.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter actives confirmation path.
items.implication: Packers RB1 role restored; monitor share vs committee.

items.text: Bucky Irving not talked about enough as true workhorse RB; full endorsement for volume role.
items.why: Workhorse designation overlooked amid other RB noise.

items.text: Put respect on Tee Higgins name; strong production call post-week.
Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 full-PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume/red-zone/targets override efficiency; backup better YPC same scheme.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via HVT despite bad running; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 + targets drive scoring; role secure.
items.conflict: Efficiency data conflicts with pure rushing projections.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 in return; Noel 15 (turf toe exit).
items.why: Clear alpha route share even with Dell return and Harrison addition.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell limited ramp.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (of 36 Mahomes) second game without Rice; career ceiling never >83 receiving yards in 37 games.
items.why: High route volume but historical production cap limits ceiling.
items.implication: Volume play but temper expectations; not true WR1 upside.
items.opportunity: Routes expanded without Rice; still efficiency-capped.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical ceiling.
